summary: Verified NEW features: optional question image upload + KaTeX math rendering across admin (TryoutBuilder), bulk import (CSV/XLSX/ZIP), student (TryoutEngine/Result), and public image endpoint. 7/7 backend tests PASS (test_iter20_math_image.py). Frontend Playwright E2E PASS: KaTeX renders in preview (4 renders), list shows 14 .katex nodes and 7 images actually loading (naturalWidth=120). Image upload via hidden input works, remove works, save closes dialog and persists both with- and without-image. Invalid LaTeX ($\frac{1$) renders .katex-error without crashing the page. ZIP import attaches gambar.png to imported questions and the returned /api/question-images/<name> URL is publicly fetchable without auth and returns image/* content-type. Non-image upload (.txt) returns 400. Student endpoint GET /api/student/tryouts/{id} returns questions with image_url field (and no correct_answers leak).

issues: DialogContent missing aria-describedby (console warning) - a11y nit

critical_code_review_comments: renderMath uses dangerouslySetInnerHTML with katex trust:false and strict:'ignore' + throwOnError:false — safe; however esc() does not escape single-quote which is fine for attributes using double quotes here.

QuestionImage uses fileUrl(src); for /api/question-images/* this concatenates REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL correctly. Caching headers set (max-age=86400) with CSP default-src 'none' + style-src 'unsafe-inline' for SVG — good.

routes_admin.py _parse_zip resolves image file by basename lowercase match — works for flat ZIPs. For nested paths users must include basename in the 'gambar' column (already documented in instructions sheet).

Template route is /api/admin/questions/template(.xlsx), not under /tryouts — review request referenced it loosely; main agent should double-check that the frontend TryoutBuilder calls the correct URL (verified via DOM fetch during test — status 200 for both).
seed_data_creation: Added ~3 test questions to tryout 'to_3' (one TEST_MATH question with image via UI; two TEST_IMPORT questions via ZIP import, one with pic.png attached). Safe to leave or delete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Templates live at /api/admin/questions/template and /api/admin/questions/template.xlsx (not under /tryouts). Image public endpoint: /api/question-images/{name} (no auth). Image upload: POST /api/questions/upload-image (admin/tutor only, 400 for non-image ext, 5MB cap). Student questions in GET /api/student/tryouts/{id} under 'questions'; image_url included; correct_answers stripped. Register body uses 'name' not 'full_name' and ignores role (always student). Tryout builder route: /admin/tryouts/:id/builder (NOT /questions).
